description: P0.3: half_twice's extra attack itself finishes off a target that survived the main hit (main hit crits for 8, leaving 1 HP; the extra half-power hit deals 4 and is the actual killing blow) -- the natural post-chain faint dispatch (onKO/onFaint/send-out) must fire off the EXTRA hit's HP change, not just the main hit's. Gen1 so ability_config/traits_config are both null -- isolates extra-attack faint timing from hook re-entry (see dragon_first_double_fatal.json / dragon_first_double_merged.json for hook-bearing fatal/merged cases).
